global_limits: Historical lane installation results are not the inverse effect of hypothetical removal
The 2025 counter, 2017 traffic counts and 2015-2017 retail surveys cover distinct places and periods
Retail correlation cannot identify a causal sales or business-closure effect
Do not scale sampled agent outcomes to the corridor or city
Do not use the multi-corridor B10 cost as a local estimate
No crash, fatality or net emissions forecast is supported
